note: Per-town fleet targets and a per-vehicle registry lookup, extracted from the LWMC fleet establishment roster (Lahore Fleet+LRs.xlsx) -- a flat per-vehicle list (Vehicle ID / Vehicle Category / Town), not an hourly snapshot. 'target_total_vehicles' is every registered vehicle assigned to that town; 'target_lr_vehicles' is the Loader Rickshaw subset. The 'vehicles' map lets build_master.py join each live VTMS vehicle to its REAL registered category/town by Vehicle ID, which is far more reliable than VTMS's own vehicle_type field (frequently blank).
